title: Review verdict (exeris-kernel)
description: The bundle's shape, narrowed to this repository's reviewing roles and scope vocabulary. The three-state `decision` and the `checks_run` contract — a check that did not run says so rather than being omitted — are the base's; only the vocabulary is local. `scope_class` is the shared pull-request template's own line, so a verdict and the PR body classify a change the same way. The base refuses nothing on its own, so every closer here is this repository's: one per object, because `unevaluatedProperties` stops at the object it sits in and a root closer leaves every array item taking any property. An item this repository does not narrow still carries the `$ref` beside its closer — without it the closer sees no declared property and refuses the base's own fields.
